items.title: Floci now has an agent skill, shipped with floci-cli
items.summary: It teaches Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Kiro and other coding agents to run the emulators with floci-cli and point your cloud tools at them. Install it with: npx skills add floci-io/floci-cli

items.title: Floci 2.2.0
items.summary: Scheduler gains retry backoff and dead-letter queue handling, and API Gateway and AppSync VTL rendering is now sandboxed with execution limits.
